description: (0.5.0, Draft) Client-cited inputs in Message.metadata io.acdp/provenance become derived_from (RFC-ACDP-0022 §7).

input.note: Run the agent against a test registry, with a client that sends the a2a-001 task (two chunks for artifactId fraud-summary) unless a scenario says otherwise.

expected.behavior: inputs [X, Y, X] across the task's messages give derived_from [X, Y]: message order, then array order, first occurrence kept.
An input that cannot be retrieved, or whose signature does not verify, is left out; the task still runs.
A value that is not {inputs: [ctx_id, ...]} (extra member, empty array, a non-ctx_id string) is ignored for provenance and never fails the task.
More than 1000 distinct verified inputs: derived_from stops at 1000.
An acdp:// string inside a Part (text or data) is not added to derived_from.
For a continuation (a2a-002 F), the earlier body's ctx_id precedes the cited inputs.
